Our client is seeking a female GP to join their long-established practice in Chermside, following the relocation of one of their female doctors to another site. This presents an excellent opportunity to step into a well-supported role with an existing patient base and the flexibility to choose between mixed or private billing. A permanent, dedicated consulting room is available, with capacity to fill a full-time equivalent load immediately. 

 The practice has been serving the community since 1997 and operates Monday to Friday, 7.00am–5.30pm (closed weekends and public holidays). It offers 15 consulting rooms, a balanced male/female GP ratio, and comprehensive treatment facilities, including a four-bed treatment room, two theatre rooms, a baby room, and two CDM rooms. Patients benefit from access to allied health services such as dietetics, podiatry, psychology, and audiometry, supported by a team of seven staff. 

 Doctors are supported with Best Practice clinical software, generous remuneration at 65% of billings, and a guarantee of the higher of $160 per hour or 30% commission fee for the first three months. Current billing rates range from $80–$97 for standard consultations and $120–$145 for long consultations. The practice also provides: 

 
	 A permanent parking spot  
	 Established patient demand, ensuring a full patient load from day one. 
	 A potential sign-on incentive, depending on contract length. 
 

 This is an excellent opportunity for a female GP seeking a permanent role with strong patient demand, flexible billing, and excellent support in a long-standing practice. 

  Essential Criteria:  

 
	 MBBS or equivalent

Job Description:  

Performing scheduled maintenance services, such as oil changes, lubrications and engine tune-ups, to achieve smoother running of vehicles. 

Repair and replacing worn and defective parts and reassembling mechanical components and referring to service manuals as needed.

Dismantling and removing engine assemblies, transmissions, steering mechanisms and other components, and checking parts. 

check and repair suspensions, brakes and wheel alignments of automotive vehicles. 

Reassembling engines and parts following repair. 

Manage stock reordering and inventory as directed, putting the stock (for example brakes, sparkplugs, oil filters) at the proper places. 

Maintain and manage tools, equipment, and machinery in good condition. 

Deliver outstanding customer service at all times, ensuring a professional and polite manner when communicating with customers.

Must hold a current driver's license and Licensed Vehicle Tester 

A desire to achieve results. 

 

Annual Salary (depending on experience/skills) between $79,000 - $82,000 plus superannuation.
